title: Split band photo reveal to wordmark
summary: From black, a thin vertical slit opens into side-by-side photo bands that swap images every quarter second, then part to uncover a full-frame texture shot where a bold wordmark rises out of a baseline mask and holds.
use_when: A fashion, beauty or lifestyle brand with strong photography and a text wordmark
A 6 s opener or chapter change that ends on the name
Teasing several product or mood photos before one hero image
Silent autoplay where the picture carries the energy

look.type_style: heavy grotesk wordmark, all caps, tight tracking, cap height ~18 % H, small registered-style superscript; tiny tracked mono labels in the two top corners (~1.5 % H)

sfx.event: wordmark settles out of its mask

structure.shot: pure black, then a thin vertical slit right of centre opens onto a monochrome collage photo
structure.camera: static frame; photo inside the slit pushes in (motion 64 %/s over sec 0, part of it is the band growth)
structure.motion: slit appears f8 at ~5 % W, widens to ~50 % W by f15 as two adjacent bands, easings.outExpo ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: montage: 4-6 vertical bands of different widths fill the frame, each band shows a different photo; photos swap every 0.25 s
structure.camera: push-in inside each band, ~1.00 to 1.04 over the row (4 %/s in sec 1)
structure.motion: band edges slide sideways and re-divide the frame each cell; photo inside a band changes on cells f15, f23, f30, f38; motion blur visible on the swap at f23 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: bands part to the edges to reveal a full-frame dark textile close-up; wordmark rises from a baseline clip at centre, corner labels already in
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00 to 1.02 on the texture, settling (motion 4 %/s)
structure.motion: two narrow cream side bars remain f38-f47 then slide off the edges; wordmark letters rise out of a clip mask, tops visible at f45, settled at f53, springs.maskRise ~15 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: wordmark centred over the textile background with two tiny corner labels; held to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the wordmark, mono for the corner labels, bg behind the opening black
params.content.photos: 4-6 photos shown inside the bands during the montage
params.content.hero: one full-frame texture or product photo behind the wordmark
params.content.labels: two tiny corner labels (location line, founding year), 2-3 words each
params.timing.swap: frames between band photo swaps (default 7-8 at 30 fps)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (0.25 s resolution). The only soft transition (0.27-1.57 s) is the whole split montage; no hard cuts. The reveal is front-loaded: everything happens by f53, then a 4.2 s static hold, so the recipe needs a reason to hold (shorten timing.hold for social). Proposed term split-band-reveal (vertical bands open and swap photos) is not in the vocabulary; mask-wipe is used in its place. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
